steps.say: Acute bacterial arthritis is the destroyer of cartilage within 24 to 48 hours through enzymes and pressure. Staphylococcus aureus is the owner of above half of adult cases. Knees lead at 50 percent. Every hot swollen joint with fever is tapped urgently.
steps.tx: Bacteria loose in a joint space define septic **arthritis**: usually blood-borne seeding that melts cartilage in days under enzyme attack and mounting pressure. **Staphylococcus aureus** owns **50 to 60 percent** of adult native-joint cases, favouring rheumatoid joints, prostheses, diabetes, failing kidneys, and used needles. A hot, swollen, locked joint with fever indicates a needle the same hour.

vis.alt: Infected joint with purulent effusion, synovial invasion, and cartilage destruction.
vis.caption: Bacteria in synovial fluid destroy cartilage within days. Same-hour aspiration with cultures decides therapy. Credit: StewardMD.

steps.say: Knees lead at 50 percent with hips, shoulders, ankles, and wrists following behind. Axial joints follow bacteremia and injection use. Hip infection is the emergency among emergencies. Site is never the changer of the urgency.
steps.tx: Half of all cases pick the **knee** (**50 percent**); hips, shoulders, ankles, and wrists divide most of the rest, while sacroiliac, sternoclavicular, and pubic joints mark bacteremia with needle use. An infected hip strangles femoral head blood flow within hours. Whatever the address, one hot joint indicates one urgent tap.

steps.say: Synovial fluid above 50000 cells with above 75 percent neutrophils is typical of sepsis. Lower counts are never the excluders of infection. Gram stain with culture in bottles plus crystal search is the companion of every tap. Blood cultures come before antibiotics always. The classical clinical picture pairs a single hot joint with fever that is tapped urgently.
steps.tx: The needle decides everything: urgent diagnostic **arthrocentesis** (joint aspiration) for Gram stain, cultures, crystal hunt, and cell counts. Counts past **50,000** per microliter at **75 to 90 percent** neutrophils scream sepsis, yet smaller counts never clear the joint. **Blood cultures** come before antibiotics without exception, and synovial fluid tipped into blood-culture bottles grows more often, identifying the germ in **80 to 90 percent**.

steps.say: Empiric therapy is the pair of vancomycin or daptomycin with a broad cephalosporin pending cultures. Courses run 3 to 4 weeks for native joints. MRSA with gram-negatives is the extender of therapy. Narrowing follows culture reports.
steps.tx: Empirical intravenous therapy starts broad, then obeys the cultures: weight-based **vancomycin (15 to 20 mg** per kg) every **8 to 12 hours**, with daptomycin as the alternative beside **ceftriaxone 2 g** daily or another third-generation **cephalosporin**. Native joints need **3 to 4 weeks** of total antibiotic therapy, more for **MRSA** (methicillin-resistant staph) and gram-negatives. The culture slip, not habit, narrows the regimen, because broad cover bridges but never plans.

steps.say: Prompt daily needle drainage until sterile is mandatory with washout for hips, shoulders, loculated, or prosthetic disease. Hips never wait for repeated taps. Pus under pressure is the destroyer of cartilage fastest. Drainage with antibiotics is the saver of joints.
steps.tx: Aspirate daily through a closed needle until fluid runs sterile; hips (always), shoulders, loculated collections, and prostheses upgrade to arthroscopic or open **washout** (surgical joint lavage). Pressurized pus melts cartilage quickest. Hips skip needle trials and go straight to theatre.

steps.say: Gonococcal arthritis gives migratory pains with tendon inflammation and sparse skin pustules in young adults. Triple-site NAAT finds the germ. Single-dose ceftriaxone 1 g with doxycycline cures it. Partners are treated together.
steps.tx: **Gonococcal** arthritis hits sexually active young adults with migratory **polyarthralgias** (wandering joint pains), **tenosynovitis** (tendon sheath inflammation), and sparse vesiculopustular lesions. **NAAT** (nucleic acid testing) of genital, rectal, and pharyngeal sites finds the germ. Single-dose **ceftriaxone 1 g** with **doxycycline** cover cures it, with partners treated together.

steps.say: Contiguous osteomyelitis is the seeder of joints from adjacent bone infection. Diabetic feet with exposed bone are the warners of spread. MRI is the mapper of the bone-joint bridge. Bone infection with joint effusion is drained as sepsis.
steps.tx: Contiguous **osteomyelitis** (adjacent bone infection) seeds joints across the cortex, mapped by MRI showing the bone-joint bridge. Diabetic foot ulcers with exposed bone warn of spread into tarsal joints. Bone infection with a joint effusion indicates septic drainage with prolonged bone-active antibiotics.

vis.alt: Long bone osteomyelitis with cortical destruction and adjacent joint seeding.
vis.caption: Bone infection crosses cortex into the joint space. MRI maps the bridge before drainage. Credit: StewardMD.

steps.say: Prosthetic infection inside 3 months keeps implants with debridement and rifampin while late disease exchanges hardware. Lyme arthritis takes 28 days of doxycycline. Each special case has its own track. Cultures with imaging pick the track.
steps.tx: Hardware younger than **3 months** usually survives with debridement plus **rifampin** combinations, while long-infected prostheses need one- or two-stage exchange. **Lyme** arthritis brings episodic big-joint swelling that yields to **doxycycline 100 mg** twice daily for **28 days**. Cultures with imaging pick each special track.
